_comment: Per-machine git identity baseline for githk_check_git_config.ps1. Copy to gitidentity.json (gitignored) and fill in real values. The real file names the default/system GitHub identity (e.g. the cross-project XplanMagic account) which must NEVER be committed to this public repo.

default._comment: The DEFAULT / system-wide git identity (NOT the Vic3 one). On this machine = the XplanMagic account.
default.name: <default-github-username>

vic3_local._comment: The Vic3 repo's LOCAL identity override + its gh-based credential helper.
vic3_local.name: HershGord

windows_credentials._comment: Expected Windows Credential Manager state. bare_host_user = who owns git:https://github.com (must be the DEFAULT account, NOT Vic3 — gh auth setup-git clobbering this is the known failure mode).

gh._comment: gh keyring accounts. vic3_active_account = which gh account must be ACTIVE for Vic3 pushes to authenticate (the gh helper serves the active account's token).
